rationale: The agent executed returns without explicit user confirmation, violating the policy requiring confirmation before any order-changing action. Tool logs show two return_delivered_order_items calls (one with multiple items and another for a separate item), but the agent’s final message only mentions submitting a return for the e-reader, creating a mismatch between actions taken and information provided. Although the agent did attempt to identify the user (name + zip) and accessed only that user’s orders, the lack of confirmation and the incorrect/incomplete final communication mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
